title: Onramp Clinics + Pattern Library: playbook and rollout
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook for recurring Onramp Clinics (led workshops) and a companion Pattern Library of SDK + Quickstart templates. Goal: reduce time-to-first-success (TTFS) for new SDK adopters and standardize best-practices for embedding Redwood APIs into sample apps. Playbook covers scheduling cadence, facilitator checklist, feedback loop into docs, instrumentation hooks, and measurement plan.
acceptance_criteria: Published playbook in Confluence with facilitator checklist and slide deck templates
3 canonical quickstart repos (Node, Python, Go) using pattern library components merged to public org
Telemetry events and dashboard track TTFS, activation rate, and cohort retention for clinic attendees vs controls
Ops runbook for monthly cohort cadence and resource owners assigned
tasks: Draft playbook skeleton and facilitator checklist
Design pattern library components and code style guide
Implement quickstart repos with CI, tests, and sample prompts
Instrument quickstarts with telemetry and wire up to internal dashboard
Schedule pilot Onramp Clinic and recruit 20 external participants
Collect feedback, iterate on artifacts, and finalize launch plan
progress_updates: 2025-10-02: Kickoff meeting held with Growth, DX, and Platform. Agreed success metrics and pilot scope (SDKs: node, python, go).
2025-10-05: Engineering spike completed for telemetry schema; agreed event names and minimal properties with infra (event: devx.quickstart.first_success).
2025-10-08: Draft playbook uploaded to Confluence (link in links). Seeking feedback from Solutions and Developer Relations teams.
2025-10-11: Design provided pattern variants for auth and example request flows. Noted trade-off: full auth integration increases friction for pilot; decide to provide both mock and real auth flows.
2025-10-15: Pilot cohort recruitment open (email list from product trials). Scheduled clinic 2025-10-28. Blocking: need A/V approval and workshop facilitator availability.
decisions: Use lightweight telemetry schema (no PII) to allow public quickstarts to report anonymized TTFS metrics
Ship three minimal quickstarts first, then expand to community-contributed variants
Clinics will be 60 minutes: 20m intro, 25m guided lab, 15m troubleshooting + feedback capture
risks: Low attendance for pilot could skew metrics; mitigation: recruit from highest-engagement trial cohort and provide incentives
Telemetry gaps if contributors disable analytics; mitigation: ensure local dev telemetry falls back to opt-in telemetry tests
Docs/SDK drift if pattern library not versioned; mitigation: add CHANGELOG and semver tags to pattern library
metrics: Time-to-first-success (TTFS): median minutes from signup to successful first API response
Activation rate: percent of clinic attendees who call API within 7 days
Cohort retention: percent using SDK after 30 days
Quickstart PR uptake: number of forks/stars and external community PRs
